name: research-engineering-router
description: Provider-configurable evidence triage and verified software/research workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence triage with your configured decision model
interface.longDescription: Routes bounded evidence decisions to a configured provider while the selected main model owns reasoning, implementation and verification. Python 3.10+ and provider configuration are required. No guaranteed token or cost savings.
defaultPrompt: Use Research & Engineering Router to select relevant evidence and verify a scoped implementation or research task.
